steps.title: Establish Project Identity
steps.description: Configure the metadata for the 3D Flashlight app including the application name and high compatibility package structure com.flashlight3d.app.

steps.title: Set Up Android Build Configuration
steps.description: Create the Gradle build script with standard settings compatible with compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, and Java 17.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest Permissions & Activities
steps.description: Set up AndroidManifest.xml declaring permissions for CAMERA, declaring hardware capabilities (flash), and configuring MainActivity as full-screen.

steps.title: Create Color Definitions
steps.description: Configure resource color values to achieve rich metallic grey shades and vibrant glow colors for the interface.

steps.title: Design Brushed Metal Background
steps.description: Create the rich gradient layout resource that represents a realistic brushed carbon-metal casing.

steps.title: Build the 3D Switch Plate Frame
steps.description: Design a realistic layer-list drawable with inner shadows and bevels representing the metallic socket in which the power button rests.

steps.title: Construct the 3D Off and On Buttons
steps.description: Build high-fidelity layer-list drawables representing the raised tactile push-button in both illuminated ON and dark/raised OFF states.

steps.title: Generate Tactile Button Selectors
steps.description: Assemble state selectors connecting physical button states to the 3D switch animations and drawables.

steps.title: Design Glowing Light Bulb Indicator Drawables
steps.description: Create vector/gradient light indicators (glow ring arrays) signifying active or inactive status states on the dashboard.

steps.title: Add Tactile Slider Tracks & Handles
steps.description: Add realistic slider tracks and polished metal thumbs for adjusting the flashing frequency of the strobe module.

steps.title: Draft the User Interface Layout XML
steps.description: Construct the relative main layout including the digital status window, the glowing bulb indicator, the main 3D switch plate, and the strobe controller bar.

steps.title: Synthesize Mechanical Audio Tones
steps.description: Write a programmatically synthesized click sound generator using Java's AudioTrack class, delivering a physical mechanical switch sound with custom frequencies for ON/OFF cycles.

steps.title: Code Flashlight and Strobe Controls
steps.description: Write MainActivity logic using Android SDK's CameraManager. Implement real-time permission handling, UI light bulb glows, strobe frequency loops, and screen brightness override.

steps.title: Building 3D Flashlight
steps.description: Compile, build, and package the 3D Flashlight app debug binary via high-speed Java/Gradle compiler environment.
